name: Qwen3.6-35B-A3B (Unsloth NVFP4)
notes: Fast MoE with 3B active. Fits on one Spark; with two it is split across both. Unsloth's DGX Spark advice for NVFP4 MoE: the flashinfer_b12x MoE backend (FlashInfer's CuteDSL MoE for SM12x), never Marlin, or inference gets much slower. Runs on the official vLLM image (0.29.1, no Ray), which has that backend. Not yet run here.
